title: Public History: Current + Analog U.S. Macro World
summary: Choose a point from a mixed 5,285-record U.S. macro public record, 1979-01-01 through 2026-05-15, spanning current, similar, and contrasting macro windows; then test a branch event or policy response from that evidence state.

comparison_windows.label: Volcker inflation fight
comparison_windows.role: similar: inflation, energy, rates, recession pressure; different: policy regime and data environment

comparison_windows.label: 1994-95 tightening and soft landing
comparison_windows.role: different: tightening cycle with a less severe macro break

comparison_windows.label: Dot-com and post-9/11 slowdown
comparison_windows.role: different: market crash, security shock, and mild recession

comparison_windows.label: Global financial crisis
comparison_windows.role: similar: bank stress, Treasury/Fed action, credit-market confidence

comparison_windows.label: COVID policy shock
comparison_windows.role: different: public-health shock with extraordinary fiscal and monetary response

comparison_windows.label: Inflation and hiking cycle
comparison_windows.role: similar: inflation, labor tightness, energy pressure, rapid rate hikes

comparison_windows.label: Current higher-rate macro regime
comparison_windows.role: current anchor: inflation, labor, Treasury yields, Fed communication, and policy uncertainty
